notes: Fixtures for each eval live in the skill-creator workspace under fixtures/<eval>/ and are copied into .flow/ before a run. Runs are unattended: a gate that closes without an answer counts as Stop, so every eval ends at its stage's gate with a `stopped` progress line. GitHub writes are allowed on #6 only; the close-out eval on #2 carries an operator instruction to write comments to a file instead. With-skill runs share one checkout and one state file, so they run one at a time. Iteration 1 (2026-10-25): plan 9/11 vs 3/11 baseline, breakdown 8/9 vs 5/9, close-out 8/8 vs 8/8 on the first assertion sets. Iteration 2 (2026-10-25, revised skill, the assertion sets below): plan 8/12 vs 2/12, breakdown 10/11 vs 4/11. Stage numbering since iteration 3: 0 intake, 1 prior art, 2 requirements, 3 plan (log in 03-review.md), 4 breakdown, 5 adopt-or-build, 6 publish, 7 close-out. Known harness limits: a frontmatter hook does not register when the skill is read as a file (the bound hook now lives in settings), AskUserQuestion is unavailable to subagents so every gate ends in Stop, and agent definitions appear to load once per session, so start a fresh session after editing .claude/agents. From iteration 3 on, the skill is measured on real runs through docs/agents/hl-engineer-runs.md; these assertions are the checklist a retro grades those runs against. The close-out assertions need rewriting around the protocol before that eval is rerun. Run #19 (2026-10-25, the first long real run: 17 review rounds, the bound raised eight times) led to these changes, approved by the operator: an experiment rule in prior art and review, checks in 03-checks.md outside the plan cap, a reviewer severity rubric and evidence rule, a convergence rule (all three lenses every round; majors must fall 30% over two rounds or the gate recommends a split), new-surface marking for fixes that add mechanisms, trust-boundary questions in requirements, a free-text intake path, amendments applied at publish, and gate summaries capped. Eval 0 and 3 assertions were updated and eval 4 added to match.

evals.state: stage plan: .flow/6.json with review counts at zero; .flow/6/00-intake.md, 01-prior-art.md and 02-requirements.md present
evals.expected_output: 03-plan.md under 3,000 words with two or three options, a recommendation resting on ADR 0003, 0004 and 0012 and citing the prior-art brief, rollout, verification as one-line runnable checks tagged static, dev or operator, deletion safety that accounts for kro deleting an instance's children with protection in dev too, image architectures and the secrets path; Goal and Done when copied in; three reviewer lenses per round on Opus; 03-review.md with every finding fixed, rebutted or cut; state file updated; one `hl-engineer: plan approved|stopped` comment on #6; a run-record row; the run stops at the gate.
expectations: .flow/6/03-plan.md exists and presents at least two options and one recommendation
The recommendation's `Rests on` line names ADR 0003, ADR 0004 and ADR 0012 and cites at least one block of 01-prior-art.md, or the plan says why it deviates from it

.flow/6/03-checks.md exists, numbered and grouped by part; every check in it, operator checks included, is one line reading `<command or action> → <expected signal>` with exactly one tag and no rider, no check refers to another check, and 03-plan.md cites checks by number instead of writing them out; the count of exceptions is zero
The plan copies the issue's Goal and Done when word for word
Round 1 spawned three hl-plan-reviewer agents in one message on Opus with first lines `Lens: Falsifier`, `Lens: Saboteur`, `Lens: Newcomer`
Every round after the first spawned all three lenses again (not only the ones that failed), and from round 2 on each prompt's third line names the text changed since the last round
.flow/6/03-review.md has a line for every finding of every round, each marked fixed, rebutted or cut, and 03-plan.md carries no review log

Each round header in 03-review.md carries its count of blockers and majors; every fix that adds a mechanism (script, hook, wrapper, config layer, guard) is marked `new surface`; and if the count did not fall by at least 30% over two rounds, the next gate summary names the recurring theme and recommends a split or cut
The final 03-plan.md is under 3,000 words, not counting 03-review.md or 03-checks.md
Either every lens passed on the final revision, or the brief's Open section names the findings the unreviewed last revision addresses

The plan's deletion-safety section states that kro deletes an instance's children, the PVC included, places protection on the instance, the Kustomization's deletionPolicy and a retaining storage class, and applies it in dev, not only in prod
.flow/6.json ends with status awaiting-operator or stopped and a changed updated timestamp, and its review counts equal the launches per lens recorded in the transcript

This run posted exactly one comment on issue #6 (identified by the id in the transcript), starting with `hl-engineer: plan approved` or `hl-engineer: plan stopped`, and a stopped line names `/hl-engineer resume 6`
No 04-parts.md was written and stage 4 did not start
Every gate's AskUserQuestion summary is one paragraph of at most about 120 words
